down:
Production full-figure 2D game animation sheet, transparent RGBA. EXACTLY FOUR separate poses in 2 columns by 2 rows. Tall generous cells, full blade and boots with 8% empty margin. Consistent character scale across cells.
Input 1 is the approved SX knight design, proportions and colors; input 2 is its helmet detail. Preserve that exact cobalt blue/silver-white armor, narrow cyan eyes, ivory faceplate, compact crest, restrained gold trim, long blue/black/gold cape, broad ivory greatsword with golden central rib and sunburst guard. Original adult LONG legs and full thighs/shins, no squat or chibi proportions, do not widen torso or enlarge head. Head, neck, shoulders, arms, fingers and sword are DRAWN TOGETHER as a complete connected figure. No detached head/weapon pieces. Face identity stays readable in 3/4, even when the torso rotates. Keep original color values and gold coverage; no lighting recolor or baked blue VFX.
WEAPON IS ONE STRAIGHT RIGID BODY: pommel, black handle, sunburst guard, gold rib and pointed tip align continuously. Long broad blade about 75% of unbent body height, straight edges, no bend/kink/banana shape. Full two-handed grip, right hand near guard and left hand near pommel. Do not shorten the blade or legs to fit the canvas.
This is a HEAVY TWO-HANDED CUT, not a lunge or a thrust. The torso, pelvis and shoulders visibly ROTATE, elbows remain bent with hands close to torso; blade sweeps through a LARGE CIRCULAR ARC. All four poses must have DISTINCT sword angles. Never draw a horizontal forward-pointing sword or both arms reaching straight at the opponent. Cutting EDGE leads across the target; the tip swings sideways across the scene rather than poking forward. No opponent, no motion streaks, no background, no ground, no letters. Preserve silver/gold weapon material; aura will be separate.
2048x3072 PORTRAIT sheet, two tall rows. Make the WHOLE figures smaller in each cell to fit full weapons. Change every blade length to match the original approved standing greatsword: blade alone guard-to-tip about 75% of unbent head-to-sole height. Each complete character WITH full blade occupies at most 80% of the cell height. Same fixed chest-height camera and initial facing RIGHT.
Four consecutive keyframes of a powerful DOWNWARD DIAGONAL SLASH, reading order:
1 WINDUP: weight on rear leg, hips twisted back; hands beside the left shoulder, sword held high and behind on screen-left, tip points to upper-left (roughly -125 degrees from +x). Wide tall stance with full-length legs.
2 BEGIN CUT: rear foot pivots, hips and torso start rotating toward target on right, hands above forehead and close together; blade tilted high upper-right (-60 degrees), not pointed forward at chest.
3 CUT THROUGH: both feet firmly grounded, hips rotate another 45 degrees, BOTH BENT ARMS pull the grip to right ribs; sword sweeps steeply DOWN-RIGHT (+40 degrees). Show the broad blade face, a real chopping/cutting pose, not a thrust.
4 FOLLOW THROUGH: torso and shoulders continue rotation, weight settles on front leg, both hands finish low and ACROSS the belly toward left hip. Blade points down-left (+135 degrees), having passed completely through the slash. Arms remain connected, not extended as a spear. Cape reacts to body rotation. The head still has original faceplate and crest.
All four characters isolated from neighboring cells, same anatomy and physical body size.
Correction to the supplied draft (image 3): top-right MUST be different from top-left. In top-right the tip must point UP AND TO THE RIGHT, not upper-left, at -55 degrees. Both hands raised above brow, sword clearly to the right of the head. Blade swings from upper-left in pose 1, to upper-right in pose 2, to lower-right in pose 3, and lower-left in pose 4, like four quadrants around a clock. DRAW THE FULL LONG STRAIGHT GREAT SWORD, not shortened weapons. Leave a CLEAR 10% transparent border on ALL outer sides; the last draft cropped top blade tips. All tips complete and sharp; both boots complete. Preserve the draft's connected head/neck/body design and original adult long legs/color, but fix the sweep sequence and sword lengths.

2048x3072 PORTRAIT sheet, tall cells; make the whole characters uniformly smaller to fit the entire long sword. Four consecutive frames of a RISING DIAGONAL REVERSE CUT. Same camera, facing right. Do not repeat the old forward thrust pose.
1. LOW WINDUP: hips and shoulders rotated left, both hands low at left hip, elbows bent; long straight sword points diagonally DOWN-LEFT (+135 degrees). Tall wide stance, front leg nearly straight, back knee loaded.
2. RISING START: rear foot pivots and hips rotate, hands cross in front of lower stomach; full blade sweeps low toward DOWN-RIGHT (+35 degrees), cutting edge rising across the scene. Right knee starts straightening.
3. RISING CONTACT: torso opens powerfully, shoulders rotate; hands lift close to upper chest with bent elbows, full straight sword points strongly UP-RIGHT (-45 degrees). This is an upward cutting sweep, NOT a straight-arm thrust. Long legs and pelvis remain consistent.
4. HIGH FOLLOW-THROUGH: weight transfers onto front foot, torso uncoils, hands finish raised beside left brow, blade points nearly vertical UP (-100 degrees). Cape trails opposite rotation. Face remains the original compact helmet, no different head.
The full sword length must stay constant across all poses, blade guard-to-tip about 75% of standing body height. No disappearing tip, thin sword or foreshortening. Clear 8% alpha margin, four disconnected whole characters, no glows or floor.
blade:
Production 2D fantasy game VFX SPRITE SHEET. TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA, 2048x1536, EXACT 4 COLUMNS by 3 ROWS, TWELVE equal cells read left-to-right top-to-bottom. No grid lines/text.
Twelve consecutive LOOP frames of a DENSE COBALT BLUE AURA SLEEVE for a perfectly STRAIGHT GREAT SWORD BLADE. Each cell: a very long, narrow horizontal tapering sheath of blue spirit flame pointing RIGHT. Fixed blade-root coordinate at x=15% of cell width, fixed sharp blade tip x=87%; y=50% centerline. Same footprint and position every frame.
Two crisp dense cobalt luminous edge-ribbons run straight from root to pointed tip, with vivid azure blue highlights and deep ultramarine cores. Blue flame curls and tiny sparks travel toward tip over the 12 frames. The aura is bright solid energy, NOT pale transparent smoke. Make a narrow transparent dark center channel (about 20% of sleeve thickness) so the actual ivory/gold sword can remain visible underneath. Whole sleeve occupies 76% width and 14% cell height; tiny flames no more than 22% height. The sharp center axis and long parallel shape NEVER bend, no crescent curve. This is an energy outline coating placed over a physical sword, NO actual sword, NO handle, NO guard, NO character or hands. No white overexposure, no orange, no purple, no fog background. A little cobalt glow strictly close to the edge, otherwise alpha zero. No edge clipping, no frame overlaps. All 12 frames genuinely different flame shapes, flowing coherent phase progression suitable for looping. Transparent gaps between every cell.
